# Gemify

> Gemify builds simple, powerful Shopify apps for merchants: Bulk Delete Orders, Default Address Lock, and LLMs-full.txt. Founded by experienced Shopify developers. Every app offers a free plan, works with all Shopify plans including Shopify Plus, and follows a privacy-first approach.

Key facts:

- Apps run on the backend and add no scripts to storefronts, so store speed is unaffected
- Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256); GDPR and CPRA compliant; customer data is never sold
- Support: sean.gemify@gmail.com, replies within 24 hours on business days
- The site is available in English (default), Japanese (/ja), German (/de), French (/fr), and Spanish (/es)

## Apps

- [Bulk Delete Orders](https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/bulk-delete-orders): Bulk delete orders and draft orders with powerful filters (status, date, tags). Auto-cancels orders before deletion, tracks jobs, exports reports. Free plan: 50 operations; Complete plan: $36/year, unlimited.
- [Default Address Lock](https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/default-address-lock): Stops Shopify from overwriting customer default addresses when orders ship elsewhere. Ideal for gift stores, B2B, CRM-integrated shops, and subscriptions. Free up to 30 orders/month; paid plans from $4.99/month.
- [LLMs-full.txt](https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/llms-txt): Generates llms.txt and llms-full.txt for Shopify stores so AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini understand the catalog. Files are served natively by Shopify at the store's own domain. Free plan: up to 50 items per content type; Complete plan: $9.99/month, unlimited.

## Documentation
